content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Affiliate asset managers earn AUM fees from mutual funds and separate accounts sold to institutions and individuals, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Insurance company earning premiums and annuity deposits, not investment management fees on managed assets."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Investment manager earning AUM fees from mutual funds and separate accounts sold to institutions, advisers and individuals."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions for placing policies, with no fund or portfolio management business."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Asset manager earning AUM fees from mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts sold through advisers and institutions."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Regulatory filing software and document services for public companies, not investment management."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Alternatives manager focused on hedge funds, private equity and private credit, not public mutual funds and ETFs."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Health savings account custodian and benefits administrator serving employers and employees, not investment management."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Mainly research, data, ratings and software subscriptions; its portfolio management is a minor, secondary line."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Private markets fund-of-funds and lending to sponsors, differing from public mutual fund and ETF management."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Primarily investment processing software and outsourced operations for financial institutions, with asset management secondary."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Fee-based investment management of separate accounts and pooled funds, though aimed at affluent individuals and families."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Software licenses and outsourced back-office operations for financial firms, not managing investment funds."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Affiliated boutique managers earn AUM fees from mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts sold via advisers and institutions."},{"label":"C15","good":true,"reason":"Sponsors and manages ETFs and active funds earning fees on fund assets, though it adds index licensing and digital assets."}]}
